encoding.background: field distance 0..vmax mm, blue = near a surface
encoding.fill: field <= 0, coloured by the nearest GT geom (fill=nearest) or, with fill=inside, orange / blue only inside the target / neighbour GT surface and the nearest non-fruit class elsewhere; with fill=support, nearest GT geom except that fruit-coloured pixels within support_band_mm above the support top (lowest GT target point) are drawn as the support (tan table, dark grey other)
encoding.dashed orange (free only): GT target outline; the target-free field no longer treats it as an obstacle
encoding.gold circles: query spheres of contact links (target_field_exclude = True) cut by the plane
encoding.grey circles: other query spheres cut by the plane

note: Recorded field values from one closed-loop request; illustration, no metric printed.

scan.definitions: on the slice: target_left = GT-target-interior pixels where the target-free field <= 0; neigh_kept = GT-neighbour-interior pixels where it is <= 0
